pr_title: hibernate-resume-generator: escape device path passed to hibernate-resume
pr_comments:
> Follow-up for #27330

Please use a commit hash for follow-up/fixes/etc. A pull request number requires going to the web interface, and also it can be ambiguous. E.g., the stable branches have a separate numbering of issues and pull requests, and the number becomes meaningless.

actually escaping in generators might be kinda fucked all over the place, as we usually should apply both specifier escaping *and* c escaping, in the right order. A quick grep reveals we sometimes do one, and other times the other. Someone really needs to clean this up properly.

issue_context.body:

254

arch

kernel 6.4.7

Read the label properly and show no messages during boot.
